versions.changelog: Remove undeclared background watcher script (_watch_and_generate.py) and private dev artifacts (lyrics drafts, out/, media/, __pycache__) from the package; reword two 'Never' phrases flagged by the security scanner. No functional changes to the on-demand generation workflow.

**Added support for lyrics and workflow output files, with key disambiguation improvements for Chinese trigger phrases.**

- Now includes sample lyrics files in English and Chinese, and new output text files for generated songs.
- Added _watch_and_generate.py as a new script for workflow management or monitoring.
- Clarified the distinction in Chinese between audio song generation and plain lyrics writing (e.g., "写歌" means generate audio, not just write text).
- Updated documentation to reflect stricter interpretation of Chinese input phrases and new outputs.
- Removed outdated documentation file skill-card.md.
Trigger-word recognition: fires on 写歌/作曲/编歌 (and English 'compose/write a song' etc.) across languages. Added explicit 'when to use / when not to use' guide.
Bump: no seed by default; image only for vibe extraction, never uploaded. English docs only.
Initial release: AceStep Audio 1.5 music generation via user-defined ComfyUI. Tags/lyrics/duration plus bpm/keyscale/timesignature/cfg/temperature sampling. Default: no seed. English docs.
